#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Compiles Real Logic's codecs with the cross-check programs and runs them.
set -euo pipefail
F=/tmp/claude-501/fixp
JAR=$F/m2/uk/co/real-logic/sbe-all/1.33.0/sbe-all-1.33.0.jar
export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-Djava.io.tmpdir=$F/jtmp"
JAVA="nix shell nixpkgs#jdk21 -c"
OPENS="--add-opens java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED --add-opens java.base/java.nio=ALL-UNNAMED --add-exports java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED"
build() { # name schema-dir main
  rm -rf "$F/rl/classes/$1" && mkdir -p "$F/rl/classes/$1"
  $JAVA javac -cp "$JAR" -d "$F/rl/classes/$1" $(find "$F/rl/gen/$2" -name '*.java') "$F/rl/$3.java"
}
build rich rich RichCheck
build big big RichCheck
build fixp fixp FixpCheck
$JAVA java $OPENS -cp "$JAR:$F/rl/classes/rich" RichCheck little > "$F/rl/rich.hex"
$JAVA java $OPENS -cp "$JAR:$F/rl/classes/big" RichCheck big > "$F/rl/bigrich.hex"
$JAVA java $OPENS -cp "$JAR:$F/rl/classes/fixp" FixpCheck > "$F/rl/fixp.hex"
wc -l "$F/rl/"*.hex
